title: Capabilities component diagram
description: The twelve capabilities and how they use one another, read from their non-test `use crate::capabilities::` imports. None uses a feature or a use case. Each child's types are in its own class diagram where it declares several.

components.name: ai
components.responsibility: How every non-player object thinks, launches its children and becomes angry (RULES C.5).

components.name: bubble
components.responsibility: The ordered list of at most 13 objects and their per-type counts.

components.name: cockpit
components.responsibility: The player's in-flight state that a reset sets again, and the missile lock.

components.name: combat
components.responsibility: Lasers, missiles, E.C.M., area blast, damage, contact, explosions, kills, bounties and the law, and the slot loop's combat steps.

components.name: equipment
components.responsibility: The twelve items, their offer by tech level, prices and effects.

components.name: market
components.responsibility: Goods, prices, availability, the market byte and the hold.

components.name: pilot
components.responsibility: The saved pilot, the start pilot, rank, legal label and contraband.

components.name: random
components.responsibility: The main and the cosmetic generators.

components.name: space
components.responsibility: Vectors, the coarse, fine and far tests, and sign-magnitude counters.

components.name: universe
components.responsibility: Galaxies, systems, names, distance, range, destinations and the charts.
